<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Bounding the Recursion: Eval, Plan Persistence and Depth Limits per Skill</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A per-Skill bound sheet making compute cost and audit reconstructibility explicit before any Skill is dispatched in anger.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-22-recursion-governance-bounds</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>16</b> &middot; type <b>rubric</b><br>
      audience <b>architect</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>The Reference Architecture, Earned</b>, <i>What makes the recursion governable</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch22-the-reference-architecture-earned.qmd</code> L117-125 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch22-the-reference-architecture-earned.html#sec-earned-recursion-governance">#sec-earned-recursion-governance</a>
    &middot; "Recursion without a bound is a generator for unbounded compute and an unauditable trail."
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill one card (these three sheets) for every Skill on your completed
    <code>WS-22-recursive-architecture-canvas</code>, at every depth, including Skills reached only through a
    subagent thread. Copy the card as many times as the canvas has Skills. For each Skill, say what single
    artefact it returns, what eval declares a pass, where its plan trace is kept and for how long, how deep it may
    dispatch and what one invocation may cost. Fill blocks A to E in order, and verify each eval claim by opening
    the path, not by asking the author.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction" style="border-left-width:2.2mm">
    <b>Nothing enforces this sheet but this sheet.</b> The chapter is explicit that the eval "lives alongside the
    bundle today &mdash; as test inputs, expected outputs, and a runner the bundle author maintains &mdash; not yet as a
    manifest field; the discipline is what matters, and the schema will catch up." No lockfile field, no CI check and
    no registry validation currently reads columns 7 to 10. Until the schema catches up, this worksheet is the
    <b>only</b> place the discipline is recorded, which is why column 18 names a person and column 20 names a date.
    A team that treats this as paperwork has no bound at all; a team that treats it as the register of record has
    one, manually.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Block A &mdash; Which Skill, and where it sits
      <span class="ws-block-note">one card per Skill on the canvas</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:6%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:30%"><col style="width:42%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>

      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b>Skill</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch22 L123 &mdash; "a Skill, of a known version"</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><small>Bundle name as it resolves in the lockfile</small></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b>Version pin</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch22 L123</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><small>The exact pin, e.g. <code>#v1.4.2</code> form. An unpinned Skill cannot be bounded.</small></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>Depth on the canvas</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">WS-22-recursive-architecture-canvas</span></td>
          <td class="fill">
            <div class="f-select"><span class="opt">1</span><span class="opt">2</span><span class="opt">3+</span></div>
            <small>Where this Skill sits in the dispatch tree drawn on the canvas</small>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td><b>Dispatched by</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch22 L121</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><small>The parent Skill or Persona. Blank only for the top-level Skill.</small></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">5</span></td>
          <td><b>Returned artefact</b></td>
          <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch22 L123 &mdash; "each level returns one well-typed artefact"</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><small><b>One</b> well-typed artefact. If two things are named here, the row is not bounded.</small></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
